summary: v4 'code is the source of truth': the wings/rooms/drawers docs layer and its agents (module-auditor, module-discoverer, freshness-scanner, reference-linker) are removed. Navigation moves to a repo map inside CLAUDE.md (FENIX:MAP markers, generated by /fx-init); behavior rules move to .claude/rules/ (always-on git-workflow + fenix-conventions, plus path-scoped per-module files). The architect → worker → tester workflow stays, driven by map sections + code entry points instead of rooms/wings. Generated docs in this repo are swept into _claude_backup/, never hard-deleted.
notes: CLAUDE.md IS replaced in this upgrade (unlike 3.x upgrades) — v4's repo map and navigation rules live there, and the 3.x routing text would actively mislead the agent. The pre-upgrade copy lands in _claude_backup/4.0.0-upgrade/CLAUDE.md; copy your Stack / Local environment / custom sections back by hand, then run /fx-init to generate the map and re-fill placeholders.

sweep_manifest_patterns walks the consumer repo's .fenix-manifest.json and moves every Fenix-recorded docs artifact (wings, rooms, drawers, _pending/_history, reference scaffolding) into _claude_backup/4.0.0-upgrade/ — auditor-filled prose is human-approved content and is archived, never hard-deleted. Hand-written files in reference/ are NOT in the manifest and stay in place; move anything still valuable into .claude/rules/ or the repo map, the kit no longer reads reference/.
docs/DISCLAIMER.md and docs/info.md are preserved unchanged (user-editable).
After the upgrade, run /fx-init: it appends/refreshes the repo map in CLAUDE.md and scaffolds any missing rules files. Then run /fx-agent rules to see the editable rules.
Upgrades from 3.0.0/3.1.0 must go through the 3.2.0 kit first — no direct JSON is shipped.
